links.comparator_used: Pre-intervention phase (May-Aug 2024) before the HIS-integrated CDSS and pharmacist consultation; not compared against a standalone tool
links.outcome: Prevalence of drug-disease interactions (absolute and relative contraindications, use-with-caution) in outpatient prescriptions
links.effect: Absolute contraindication prevalence decreased significantly (P < 0.05); relative contraindication fell from 0.33% to 0.01% (P < 0.05); 'use with caution' interactions fell from 0.20% to 0.13% (P < 0.05). The effect is of the combined CDSS-in-HIS plus pharmacist intervention.
links.quote: The integration of CDSS into HIS and pharmacist interventions were associated with significantly reduced harmful DDSIs in high-risk CV-DM patients.

links.comparator_used: Pre-intervention phase without CDSS and pharmacist consultation; not compared against alerts sent directly to prescribers
links.outcome: Prevalence of drug-disease interactions and acceptance of pharmacist interventions
links.effect: Relative contraindications fell from 0.33% to 0.01% (P < 0.05). Pharmacist interventions were largely fully accepted and none were rejected. The effect is of the combined CDSS plus pharmacist intervention.
links.tradeoff: A few gout-related interventions were only partially accepted.
links.quote: The rate of relative contraindication plummeted from 0.33% to 0.01% (P < 0.05).

design_hint: CDSS integrated in HIS with pharmacist review/consultation
